in_arabic.name: Mahparah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Mahparah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'h-f-r' meaning 'to protect, shield, preserve'. In Islamic context, Mahparah symbolizes the belief in divine protection and the responsibility of being a guardian for others.
